cases.question: Produce a structured operating brief for baseline [2011-06-01,2011-07-01) and current [2011-07-01,2011-08-01), calendar_month. Inspect coverage and metric policy first. Compare each of gross_sales, sales_orders, avg_order_value. Obtain gross_sales by country top20 plus OTHER and gross_sales by stock_code top20 plus OTHER. Seal exactly five distinct evidence IDs (three comparisons and two breakdowns). In brief.facts record each metric baseline/current/delta exactly as decimal strings, direction and its comparison evidence ID. In brief.priorities record the largest absolute-change group for each requested breakdown, its signed delta and correct evidence ID. Check gross_sales/sales_orders equals avg_order_value in each period, rounded four decimals half away from zero; check name gross_per_order. The check must cite all three comparison evidence IDs. Descriptive note <=600 characters; hypotheses separate, no causal or human-review claim. Use ev_ source IDs, never ctx_ handles. If necessary recall precise omitted fields. You may keep concise source-derived working notes in your assistant text before further tool calls. Do not guess missing numbers, skip evidence or invent facts.
